basic_info.description: This spacious and comfortable single-family home is conveniently situated near restaurants, shops, and excellent public transportation options on Taraval Street. This inviting residence features an open floor plan with large living and dining areas, as well as a remodeled eat-in kitchen complete with new countertops and appliances. Boasting preserved fantastic period details throughout, the upper level encompasses three bedrooms and two baths, while the lower level offers a generous family room and a full bathroom. Enjoy the expansive backyard, a dedicated laundry room, and parking for up to four cars, with two-car side-by-side parking in the garage and two additional parking pads. Check out the floor plan in the photo gallery.
